comingSoon.eyebrow: 金融服務 · 即將登場
comingSoon.title: 解鎖收藏卡流動性
comingSoon.body: Grade10 Finance 是專為高淨值藏家打造的卡牌融資服務，其核心涵蓋真偽鑑定審核、多維度市場分析與安全託管保障。預計於 2026 年第四季推出，最終服務條款以官方發佈為準。

hero.title: Unlock Liquidity from Your Premium Assets
hero.sub: A planned card-backed financing desk for high-value collectors, built around authenticity review, market context, and compliant pre-launch interest.

disclaimer.terms: Service availability, eligibility, interest rates, fees, and terms remain subject to final Product Terms and Conditions.
disclaimer.website: Please refer to Grade10 Finance website for details. The website is expected to be launched in Q4 2026, please stay tuned.

warning.repayment: Warning: You have to repay your loans. Don't pay any intermediaries.

liquidity.title: Built for Card-Backed Liquidity
liquidity.sub: Compact, specialist-led review for collectors who need a finance conversation shaped around collectible assets.

funding.title: Flexible Funding
funding.text: Designed for collectors who want to explore liquidity without immediately selling prized assets.

retain.title: Retain Collection
retain.text: Card-backed discussion keeps the collectible as the core reference point throughout the review.

review.title: Specialist Review
review.text: Grade10 evaluates authenticity, market context, condition signals, and collection composition.

categories.title: High-Value Categories
categories.text: Initial interest focuses on Pokemon, One Piece, sports cards, and other liquid collectible segments.

how.title: How It Works
how.sub: A staged review path for pre-launch interest. It is not a live application, approval process, or published loan offer.

register.title: Register Interest
register.text: Share contact details and a non-binding overview of the cards or portfolio you would like reviewed.

submit.title: Digital Submission
submit.text: Submit the requested portfolio and card details through the planned Grade10 Finance digital channel after launch.

appraise.title: Expert Appraisal
appraise.text: Grade10 reviews authenticity, grading details, comparable market signals, and collection context.

vault.title: Secure Vaulting
vault.text: Eligible assets are expected to follow secure custody requirements before any financing discussion proceeds.

fund.title: Execute & Fund
fund.text: Any execution and funding discussion remains subject to final Product Terms and Conditions at launch.

compliance.title: Preparatory Phase Only
compliance.body: Grade10 Finance is in a preparatory and testing phase. Launch date, eligibility, interest rates, fees, custody requirements, and all financing terms remain subject to final Product Terms and Conditions.

access.title: Be First When We Launch
access.body: Grade10 Finance is expected to launch in Q4 2026. Leave your details and we'll reach out before it goes live.

live.a: No. The service is in a preparatory and testing phase. Please refer to Grade10 Finance website for details. The website is expected to be launched in Q4 2026, please stay tuned.

offer.q: Will the form provide an instant offer?
offer.a: No. The portfolio preview is non-binding and does not publish rates, loan amounts, approval criteria, or eligibility terms.

cards.a: Initial review interest focuses on high-value graded Pokemon, One Piece, sports cards, and other selected collectible categories.

terms.q: When will final terms be available?
terms.a: Launch date, eligibility, interest rates, fees, custody requirements, and all terms remain subject to final Product Terms and Conditions.
